title: PluginHUB Plugin
description: Download this Plugin for Linking us and use it, if you are our partner.
body:
# PluginHUB

### 🧩 About
**PluginHUB** is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that provides direct links to our official PluginHUB platforms.  
It’s mainly intended for **partners, supporters, and friends of PluginHUB** who want to represent or support our network.

By installing PluginHUB, players on your server can easily access our community links and find out more about us.

---

### ⚙️ Commands
| Command | Aliases | Description |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `/pluginhub` | `/phub` | Shows PluginHUB command list |
| `/pluginhub discord` | `/pluginhub dc` | Shows our [Discord invite link](https://discord.gg/95ekxaGNB3) |
| `/pluginhub mobilestars` | – | Shows [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/user/Mobilestars109), [GitHub](https://github.com/Mobilestars), and [PayPal](https://paypal.me/mobilestars109) links for Mobilestars |
| `/pluginhub fernsehheft` | – | Shows Modrinth link for [Fernsehheft](https://modrinth.com/user/fernsehheft) |
| `/pluginhub youtube` | `/pluginhub yt` | Links to our [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@PluginHUBMC) channel |
| `/pluginhub instagram` | `/pluginhub insta` | Links to our [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/pluginhubmc/) page |
| `/pluginhub tiktok` | – | Links to our [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@pluginhubmc?_t=ZN-90JrTYwk8He&_r=1) profile |
| `/pluginhub paypal` | – | Support us via [PayPal](https://paypal.me/mobilestars109) |
| `/pluginhub website` | – | Link to our [Website](https://pluginhub.de) |

---

### 🧾 Permission
| Permission | Default | Description |
|-------------|----------|--------------|
| `pluginhub.use` | ✅ true | Allows players to use `/pluginhub` commands |

---

### 🎨 Customization
Enable or disable a **gradient prefix** in the plugin’s configuration.

**config.yml**
```yaml
prefix:
  gradient: false
